public_body: Fall River City Council Committee On Finance
overall: The AG found no violation: the Committee approved its April 26 minutes on June 6, past the May 31 deadline, but the brief delay had good cause because the staff member preparing them fell ill. Resolved by informal action with no order.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee on Finance failed to timely approve the minutes of its April 26 meeting, approving them only on June 6.
allegations.key_passage: Here, however, where a specific employee was tasked with preparing the minutes and had nearly completed the minutes but then was unexpectedly and temporarily out of work due to illness before the minutes could be completed, we find good cause for the very short delay in approval of the minutes of the April 26 meeting and find that the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law.
